name: Domenego Zulian
firstMemory: I am Domenego Zulian, born in the Venetian parish of San Zulian in the year of Our Lord 1268; in my twenty-third year the Grand Council drove all the furnaces out of the city onto Murano for fear of fire, and I went with the fires, a glassblower with soot in his lungs and no name worth carving.

mortals.name: Marina Zulian
mortals.description: my elder sister, who keeps the furnace accounts and forges our dead father's hand better than he ever wrote it

mortals.name: Fra Ludovico
mortals.description: a priest of Santa Maria e San Donato who buys my reliquary glass and asks nothing about the hours I keep

mortals.name: Piero Sagredo
mortals.description: my apprentice, gap-toothed and fourteen, who worships me and steals my tools

skills.name: Glassblowing
skills.description: I gather molten cristallo on the pipe and draw a goblet stem thin as a wasp's waist

skills.name: Reading the Fire
skills.description: I know a furnace's heat by the colour at its throat and never need to test it

skills.name: Guild Silence
skills.description: I keep the furnace secrets; under the Council's law a glassmaker who talks abroad loses his hands

resources.name: The Furnace at Calle dei Conterie
resources.description: my father's glasshouse on Murano: three crucibles, a wood-yard, and a chimney that never goes cold

resources.name: The Book of Batches
resources.description: a soot-stained quire of recipes, Syrian soda ash and manganese in my father's proportions

resources.name: La Nona
resources.description: a flat-bottomed sandolo, tarred black, that I row across the lagoon by night

laterMemories.text: Marina Zulian holds her hand in the glory hole of The Furnace at Calle dei Conterie until the wardens admit no woman could fake such a burn for a lie; I bind her wrist in the water trough and say nothing, because Guild Silence is the only inheritance our father left me.
traits: The Furnace at Calle dei Conterie

laterMemories.text: Fra Ludovico pays me in candle-ends and absolution for a phial of blood-red cristallo; Reading the Fire, I draw it out the instant the manganese clears, and he weeps at the colour of it.
I teach Piero Sagredo to row La Nona blind through the lagoon fog to San Michele, and when he asks what is wrapped in the wet sailcloth under the thwart I tell him it is sand.

immortal.name: Zoe Kalamare
immortal.description: a Greek glass-factor out of Constantinople who has bought Murano cristallo for two hundred years without ageing a day; her hands do not burn

mark.name: Glazed Hands
mark.description: my palms are fused smooth and clear as cristallo where she held them in the fire; I wear a blower's leather mitts by day and by night

curseMemory.text: Zoe Kalamare steps into the mouth of the furnace and beckons me after her, and when I take her hands in the fire my Glazed Hands come out cool while everything human in me burns off like dross.
